title: 3 decisions from the audit (S8) only you can make
detail: The audit failed on items the team is fixing now, plus three that need you. Accept the recommended answer or change it.

items.q: Gates G0 (plan), G1 (owner answers) and G2 (scope) were approved by me playing you in the demo (D1-D4). Do you confirm them as your own?
items.rec: Yes, I confirm G0, G1 and G2 as recorded in D1-D4.

items.q: Four MVP acceptance criteria describe features that are R1, not built: reserved desks (BK-8 c6, RP-3 c3), blocking a desk (RP-3 c1), a booking made by a manager (BK-10 c2). Move them or build them?
items.rec: Move these 4 criteria to the R1 stories; MVP scope and points stay as they are.

items.q: The contract lint (Redocly) and the dependency vulnerability scan (npm audit, OWASP dependency-check) need the internet and were blocked here. Who runs them?
items.rec: You run them once on your machine or in Jenkins with the commands in 05-ops.md; the team fixes whatever they report before go-live.
